videos.title: Train Guard Ka Khofnak Safar | Raat Ki Kahaniyan #shorts
videos.topic: An overnight train guard checks a completely empty sleeper bogie, only to find his own dead grandfather sitting on the top berth meticulously packing a suitcase.
videos.style: Pehla shakhs (main) apni aap beeti sunata hai, dheemi aur sargoshi wali awaaz mein

videos.title: Lahore Studio Wedding Photo Mein Murda Uncle Ka Chehra #shorts
videos.topic: A wedding photographer editing late-night portraits in a Lahore studio notices a smiling uncle in the background of every single family picture—a man who has been dead since the venue was a barren graveyard.
videos.style: Ajeeb phone call, message ya voice note jo nahi aana chahiye tha
